author: Rombeyy
body:
Application
Age: 16
Timezone: GMT -3
Do you have access to TeamSpeak? Yes
Do you have access to Skype? Yes
Do you have access to a recording software? Yes 

CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION

Do you have any experience as a staff member on any servers? Yes I've been staff for a long time on HCF servers such as pure pvp, para pvp, xplogaming and HCGames

What is your biggest weakness and how do you believe it will affect your moderating? What is your biggest strength and how would this affect your moderating?
i think that my biggest weakness is that some times I could get a bit inactive because of school and tests but I could come back ASAP.

My biggest strength it's the ability of know a lot of hacked and ghost clients since I am an HCF player ( so I can ss someone if it's required) or just simply banning a kid , and my other strength it's how active I am u can always or at least most of the time u will see me in game so I'm a pretty active player.


How do you believe you can help improve the Staff Team? 
I think I can help with stuffs around hacked clients since as I said before I'm an HCF player I know a lot about hacked clients

What qualities does a leader need to have in your opinion? Do you consider yourself to be a leader? Why?
A leader needs to be a guy with potential, a guy that could handle situations that any other guy could, someone that know how his team works and that know how to make them work. No, I never liked to be a leader I always liked to have someone higher to ask what am I doing wrong or someone to asks tips or things like that.

What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator?
My experience that I think that not many players have, im an active player on HCF servers and I'm always trying to get ranks and stuffs that could help me to get closer to the staffs and improve things about my self and about wat I know with hacks and methods to find them.

What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills?
Im a simple guy, everyone knows who I am and how I am, I think that in my 3/4 months in this network I've made lots of friends and people that like me, so I think that I can be a staff that could be closer to the community.

yes I think I have them, as I said in this short period that I spend on the network I'm already friend of lots of ppl and everyone knows who I am and how I am.

How much time can you commit to being a staff member (Rough Idea)? Like 5/6 hours per day maybe 7/8 without having any problem.


CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS

You are currently undergoing your junior moderator trial. A ban evader is online and he is constantly ban evading and hacking. You are the only one online and the only one who is able to be online. What would you do? If I'm not able to ban him, i should take a screenshot or record a video of this and post it on the slack/discord and let the staff know about this guy, but if I'm able to ban him then I would record him and then ban him.


Another staff member is constantly joining and harassing other people on Teamspeak in their team channel. The staff member is also referee and has physical permissions to be in that channel. However the leaders do not want this staff member in there and they have asked him to leave multiple times. What would you do?
I should join the channel and ask what its happening and then ask the referee wats the problem with this team and his member, if he still doing it I would call a higher and see his perspective on this situation.


A player appeals a punishment you gave them. You realise that the evidence file is corrupted and therefore there is no physical evidence. You know however this person did indeed break the rules, what would you do? I would have to unban him since there is any proof about this, and then I should wait for him and see if he it's going to do it again.

You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confident but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do?
I will ask him if he can delete that screenshot and if he can't I should try to talk with a higher and see what he thinks about this.

One day the Senior Staff team makes a decision you do not agree with. You do not know all the details of the decision or the circumstances in which they were made and you were simply told by another staff member. However you do not like the decision based from what you know. What would you do?
I would try to talk with the higher/staff that talked about this and made this decision and ask him the details about this and if I still not agreed with that, I would tell him and let him know why I'm not agreed


CRITERIA 3: OTHER
NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.


What would getting moderator on Avicus mean to you? It would mean a new step for me on the server, I'm always trying to help on server, from being a Spanish translator or being on the staff team, I want to be on the team since the first time I came, I applied to Spanish translator but I didn't get it, But I still want to help the community and the network in general being a mod 


How passionate are you about Avicus? What does Avicus mean to you? I'm rlly passionate with the network I've made 2 videos on my channel about this server and I haven't upload in idk like 6 months or so, and I will try to keep getting new players once I buy my new Pc 

Avicus means a server where I can come and chill, a server where I can easily make friends since the server have one of the best communitys by far, it's a rlly close one were we all know each other.


Do you speak any other languages than English? Yes I do, Spanish 


Do you have anything else to add to your application?
No, i think that I already said everything about my self and about what I think about the server and the community
